packageRules.description: Bundle all upgrades across Node dependencies, workflow actions, and custom action configs into a single PR
prBodyNotes: ### ⚠️ Testing Instructions for Central GitHub Actions Updates
- [ ] Verify that custom actions compilation/build steps succeed (if using a build step).
- [ ] Trigger a test run of dependent workflows in a scratch/test branch if applicable.
- [ ] Ensure node_modules and action entrypoints remain correctly referenced.

packageRules.description: Annotate PRs modifying the production catalog to remind devs to increment the root version key
prBodyNotes: > **Action Required**: This PR modifies production runtimes. Remember to **increment the version number** in the root `package.json` and release an updated Git tag so downstream consumer repositories pull the updated logic.

packageRules.description: Annotate PRs modifying devDependencies or the dev catalog that they do NOT need a root version bump
prBodyNotes: > **Notice**: This PR only impacts local testing, linting, or internal developer utilities. The root repository version **should not be incremented** for this change.
